filePlacementPatterns.name: Application code stays in src/
filePlacementPatterns.why: The repo contract keeps product code under src/ and supporting material outside it.

filePlacementPatterns.name: Task reasoning lives in plans/
filePlacementPatterns.why: Feature work is expected to become explicit plan artifacts before broad edits.

workflowPatterns.name: Validate before merge
workflowPatterns.why: The repo relies on one validation entrypoint and health checks instead of ad-hoc confidence.

workflowPatterns.name: Document AI provenance in pull requests
workflowPatterns.why: Reviewers need to know what the AI changed, what a human checked, and where risk remains.

reviewPatterns.name: Prefer minimal file scope
reviewPatterns.why: Broad diffs hide reasoning mistakes and make regressions harder to spot.
